Each sitemap contributes to a cumulative URL count, which GSI models using probabilistic inference on crawl outcomes. The path taxonomy segmentation partitions this graph into subgraphs by sport or category, enabling GSE to perform state transitions based on user intent. The URL indexing layer provides granular access control and semantic tagging. Dualities emerge in that sitemap success implies robustness in URL discovery, while path segmentation reflects content hierarchy. Failure modes include 404 errors, which indicate broken links or misconfigured sitemaps, disrupting both GSI’s probabilistic models and GSE’s routing logic. These failures propagate through the system unless mitigated via redundancy checks.
